archetypes.name: harness-partition
archetypes.rationale: The diff relies on disjoint pytest selectors across many Makefile targets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Makefile pytest slices for overlap, uncovered tests, and filename-keyword collisions. Pay special attention to catch-all expressions, retired target removal, and the test_release.py classify-bump exclusion. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: relevant-checks
archetypes.rationale: Sliced targets can shrink run-relevant coverage if mappings miss a partition.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify python/checks.py and python/test_checks.py preserve the former full-file breadth for design_lifecycle.py, plan_quality.py, design_summary.py, plan_review_panel.py, and rendering.py. Check that deleted targets are not still referenced. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
